summary: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon eliminated two senior Hezbollah commanders — Abu Hassan Alaa of the Badr unit and Ali Samir Al-Haj Hassan of the Radwan Force — in retaliation for an explosive drone attack that seriously wounded three Israeli soldiers. The IDF conducted multiple strikes in Gaza targeting Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives in Khan Younis and Nuseirat, marking a fifth consecutive day of operations. A fabricated quote attributed to IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi claiming Iran would never abandon nuclear weapons briefly influenced Israeli and U.S. leadership before being debunked.
key_points: IDF killed two senior Hezbollah commanders in Deir al-Zahrani and Ansar, Lebanon, responding to an explosive drone attack that seriously wounded three soldiers. (Source: @manniefabian/58977)
IDF struck a PIJ operative in Khan Younis and a Hamas operative in Nuseirat, Gaza, within one hour, both targeting imminent terror plots. (Source: @almogboker78/17977)

A fabricated quote falsely attributed to IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi on nuclear ambitions reached Netanyahu and U.S. officials before being debunked by The New York Times. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6339)

Jared Kushner will meet Egyptian officials in El Alamein to discuss Trump's Gaza plan. (Source: @yediotnews25/133982)
U.S. Central Command published a map showing Israel including all Judea and Samaria. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94166)
An IAF Major faces a hearing for allegedly betting on Polymarket on IDF strike timings in Iran and Yemen. (Source: @pkpoi/143622)
CNN reports USS Lincoln crew suffering food shortages, black mold, and suicidal thoughts after Iranian strikes disrupted supply lines. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385149)
